description: Analyzes a call transcript and returns six structured blocks: dialogue summary, contact reason, identified action, theme label, predominant sentiment and identified participants with roles, names, confidence and evidence; use it for a fast, generic diagnosis of what happened in a call, and use /v1/analyze/riskAudit instead when the goal is compliance violation auditing. Provide at least one of dialog (primary source: diarized transcript in the format 'Speaker 1: [00:00:00.540 - 00:00:01.139] text', speaker labels accepted in any case as Speaker, Interlocutor, Hablante, Locutor or Orador plus number) or text (plain transcript fallback), each up to 300,000 characters; when dialog is used duration_seconds is required by the schema and, when provided, must be >= the last turn end time. Required: language; optional: model (always 'falaai-diagnostic-1'), audio_events, response_language (language of the results, defaulting to language), participants (up to 10 with interlocutor and optional name and role agent/client/bot, ground truth when the role is informed and otherwise inferred), call_direction (inferred when omitted), client_reference_id (echoed verbatim, charset [A-Za-z0-9 _/:.-], max 60). Returns id, object 'analysis', response_language, analysis with the six blocks, usage (characters, credits_consumed, processing_ms) and html_report (base64 gzip) only when dialog is provided; with text-only input the participant roles are forced to confidence 'low'. This call consumes credits and the amount actually charged is returned in usage.credits_consumed. Stateless: neither the transcript nor the analysis is persisted (only billing and usage metadata is logged), protecting personal data under LGPD. IMPORTANT: this call charges credits and the result is NOT stored — you MUST read the FULL response and relay ALL of its information to the user (all six blocks, usage and html_report; no omissions, no shortening), and persist it if the user may need it later; calling again charges again.
name: diagnostic
